violations.description: Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was reused or used more than one time. Single use cardboard was being used as a shelf liner.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device.
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
Provided as required, designed, constructed, installed, maintained, and cleaned (1 pt deducted)
Available, adequate capacity, able to maintain proper temperature (4 pts deducted)
Hot holding and cold holding temperatures maintained, unwrapped food not reserved (5 pts deducted)
